base, job_path = sys.argv[1:]

digest = hashlib.sha256(text).hexdigest()
job = {
  'assignee': 'builder-b',
  'expected_outputs': ['count.py'],
  'instructions': {'path': 'task.txt', 'sha256': digest},
  'job_id': 'demo-0001',
  'release': 'fixture release',
  'reviewer': 'codex-prime',
  'routed_by': 'router-fixture',
}
pathlib.Path(job_path).write_text(json.dumps(job), encoding='utf-8')
print(digest)
